title: IBM Storage Scale System 6.2.3.0 through 6.2.3.6, and 7.0.0.0 through 7.0.1.0 and IBM Storage Scale 6.0.0.0 through…
description: IBM Storage Scale System versions 5.2.3.0 through 5.2.3.8, 6.0.0.0 through 6.0.1.0, 6.2.3.0 through 6.2.3.6, and 7.0.0.0 through 7.0.1.0 contain a vulnerability that allows an attacker to use an undocumented flag to access an unauthenticated path in the REST API. This could lead to unauthorized access with high confidentiality and integrity impact but no availability impact.
